title: Cycle Classes: Necessary Direction and Open Converse
mathematical_role: Expose the cycle-class map, its established algebraic-to-Hodge direction, its noninjectivity, and the separate rational-surjectivity question that constitutes the Hodge conjecture.
learning_objective: Read cl^p as a map from codimension-p algebraic cycles to degree-2p cohomology of type (p,p), then distinguish that necessary direction from the open rational converse.
literal_semantics: Z^p(X) is generated by irreducible codimension-p algebraic subvarieties.
The integral cycle-class map lands in degree-2p cohomology and algebraic cycle classes have Hodge type (p,p).
The cycle-class map need not be injective; homologically trivial cycles map to zero.
The rational Hodge conjecture asks whether Im(cl^p tensor Q) equals all rational degree-2p classes of Hodge type (p,p).
Smooth projectivity over C and rational coefficients are structural to the Clay statement.
nonliteral_semantics: The left-to-right arrow does not assert injectivity or surjectivity.
The dashed converse box is a question, not an established theorem.
The plate does not extend the statement to integral coefficients or arbitrary compact Kahler manifolds.

notes: Candidate semantics are bounded by the existing documentary source; no new mathematical source is admitted by this visual operation.

accessibility.alt_text: A cycle-class map sends codimension-p algebraic cycles to degree-2p cohomology classes of type p,p, while a separate dashed box asks whether every rational p,p class lies in the rationalized image and labels that converse open.
accessibility.long_description: The upper row shows Z^p(X) mapping by cl^p to integral degree-2p cohomology whose complexification has Hodge type p,p. Text states that this algebraic-to-Hodge direction is established and that the map is not injective. A lower dashed box writes the rational image-equality question and states that the integral and unrestricted Kahler analogues are false in general.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: The plate correctly separates the established necessary direction of the cycle-class map from the open rational surjectivity statement.

supersession_reason: Replace an unlabeled decorative arrow with the actual cycle-class map, coefficient/category guardrails, and the open converse.
